text:
maria: Quick sync — bringing MPT-30B-redwood-v2 into serving. Weights landed at s3://redwood-weights/prod/mpt-30b/v2/ (sha256: d4f7...). Tokenizer is byte-bpe variant, note special unk token mapping — see below. Need quant plan (AWQ vs GPTQ vs FP8), calibration dataset sign-off, and a quick config validation before staging deploy.

tonny: small typo — you mean tony not tonny ;). On config: I ran the schema check, 1 warning on `max_seq_length` vs model checkpoint. Paste snippet: ```json
{
  "model_name": "mpt-30b-redwood-v2",
  "weights_path": "s3://redwood-weights/prod/mpt-30b/v2/",
  "tokenizer": { "type": "byte_bpe", "unk_token": "<|unk|>" },
  "max_seq_length": 2048
}
```

alex: quick note on tokenizer quirks — the original repo uses `<|unk|>` mapped to id 0 but the tokenizer we'll deploy currently reserves id 0 for padding. I pushed a tiny patch to the tokenizer mapping in the onboarding branch that swaps pad<->unk and adds a compatibility shim. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/c/1234

sophie: calibration dataset — what's the size & composition? I need to sign off on representativeness for summarization and codegen evals. FP8 might need more diverse cal data.

quant-qa-bot: AWQ calibration run (sample): calib_size=1280, tokens=3.2M, heads=multi; metrics: RougeL drop AWQ vs fp16 = 0.8%, GPTQ = 0.35%, FP8 (sim) = 0.2% but unstable on long sequences. Full logs: s3://redwood-weights/calib/mpt-30b/v2/awq-run-2026-03-16/

deploy-bot: staging canary started for mpt-30b-redwood-v2 (canary id: c-789). Route: staging-us-west. Monitor p95 latency and errors.

maria: thanks. Tradeoffs: AWQ => fastest & lowest cost (~30% token-cost reduction) but ~0.8% rouge loss on summarization suite; GPTQ => middle ground (~15% cost reduction, 0.35% loss); FP8 => lowest loss but longer compile/test and possible runtime instability on 2048+ sequences. My proposal: AWQ for staging-only smoke, run full GPTQ calibration overnight, then decide for prod after eval. Need sign-off from @sophie for staging and @tony for config rollback hooks.

tony: pls add a fallback route in the model routing policy to `mpt-30b-redwood-v2-fp16` with priority 0. Example policy snippet: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: default
    model: mpt-30b-redwood-v2-awq
  - name: fallback
    model: mpt-30b-redwood-v2-fp16
    priority: 0
```

alex: I'll kick off GPTQ overnight with the same eval set used in calib. Command I used: `./scripts/run_quant.sh --model s3://redwood-weights/prod/mpt-30b/v2/ --method gptq --calib-size 4096 --out s3://redwood-weights/calib/mpt-30b/v2/gptq-2026-03-16`

sophie: staging OK for AWQ smoke as long as a) we tag the eval dataset and b) we add a Canary SLO of max 2% rouge regression alert for automatic rollback. Approve staging AWQ. Not approving prod AWQ yet.

quant-qa-bot: GPTQ preliminary numbers (after 4k calib): RougeL drop = 0.34%, perplexity +0.2. Inference memory ~+6% vs AWQ, latency ~+10% p95. Artifacts: s3://redwood-weights/calib/mpt-30b/v2/gptq-2026-03-16/summary.json

maria: perfect — i'll update onboarding checklist: add tokenizer shim, add routing fallback, tag eval dataset, and start staging canary for AWQ. I'll open a PR to the infra repo with the route policy + canary SLO.

alex: FYI I discovered a corner case — tokenizer padding-compat shim may change token ids for some rare special tokens used by our internal filters. I'll add a mapping file to the model bundle: `token_id_map.json` and the runtime will translate on load.

maria: good call. Make sure the map is in the same weights bucket and the model manifest includes `token_id_map.json`. Example manifest entry: ```json
"files": [
  "pytorch_model.bin",
  "tokenizer.json",
  "token_id_map.json"
]
```

tony: once PRs are up ping me. I'll review the policy and approve the fallback.

deploy-bot: canary health: 10m check — p50 60ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.2% (within thresholds).

maria: next steps: alex run GPTQ overnight, quant-qa-bot post final numbers tomorrow AM, tony review infra PR, sophie approve staging SLOs. If GPTQ meets <0.5% loss we can consider it for prod, else we'll schedule FP8 experiment (longer runway).

sophie: ack. tagging this thread in the onboarding checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
